meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用统一 Python 接口访问 40 多个生物信息学数据库(UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),检索序列、找通路、搜化合物、跨库转换 ID,并支持 BLAST 等分析。
howto.when: 当用户要求同时查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome)、做跨库 ID 映射或整合分析时触发;单库快速查询改用 gget,序列或文件处理用 biopython。

say.text: 查 UniProt 里 ZAP70 的序列,再映射到 KEGG 找相关通路。
say.note: 会调用 UniProt 检索和 ID 映射。

say.text: 搜 KEGG 化合物 Geldanamycin,再转成 ChEMBL ID。
say.note: 走 KEGG 查询加 UniChem 跨库映射。

say.text: 帮我找人类基因 TP53 参与的所有 KEGG 通路。
say.note: KEGG 按基因返回相关通路。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the bioservices Python package to access 40+ bioinformatics services: retrieve sequences/annotations, find pathways, search compounds, map IDs across databases, run BLAST.
howto.when_en: Triggered when querying multiple bio-databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in one workflow or doing cross-database ID mapping. Use gget for single-db lookups; biopython for sequence/file tasks.

say_en.text: Look up ZAP70 in UniProt, then map the ID to KEGG pathways.
say_en.note: Calls UniProt search plus ID mapping.

say_en.text: Find Geldanamycin in KEGG, then map the compound to ChEMBL.
say_en.note: Uses KEGG search and UniChem mapping.

say_en.text: Find all KEGG pathways that contain the human gene TP53.
